testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.contacts.paged.ContactSearchPagedDataSourceTest_letterHeaders

testcase.name: each letter group yields exactly one header anchored to its first contact
a letter group split across two page loads still yields a single header on the first page
letter header lands on registered contact even when an unregistered system contact outranks it alphabetically
letter header reflects the sort name, not the display name, when a nickname diverges from the profile name
